description: Get dated price rows for up to 5 commodities between a start date and an optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), aggregated hourly, daily, weekly or monthly. Use when the user needs the actual series (e.g. daily Brent and heating oil from 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30) rather than summary statistics over a fixed window, which opa_get_history returns. Results are paged at up to 500 rows per page across all requested codes, newest rows first: page 1 holds the most recent dates and later pages go back in time; within a page each code's rows are listed oldest to newest. The answer states the page count and says when more pages exist. The API clamps the start date to the account's plan history depth and the answer reports the window the API actually applied. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

commodities.description: 1-5 commodity names or codes (e.g. ['brent', 'HEATING_OIL_USD']). The API refuses more than 5 codes per request.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today; a future end date is capped to now by the API.

interval.description: Aggregation bucket: hourly, daily, weekly or monthly (default: daily).

per_page.description: Rows per page across all requested codes, 1-500 (default: 250).

start_date.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Must not be in the future.

name: opa_get_history_range
title: Get Price History for a Date Range
